definitions.explanation: The area near one's home; nearby surroundings.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{近所|きんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go shopping at the neighborhood supermarket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してきた→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{近所|きんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I just moved here and don't know the neighborhood well yet.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧。
{近所|きんじょ}⟦{付|づ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}だ→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think neighborly relations are important.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}くて→良い：02350_yoi⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm on good terms with my neighbors, and we often eat together.

notes:
{近所|きんじょ} means 'neighborhood' or 'vicinity.'

Common expressions:
- {近所|きんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: neighbors
- {近所|きんじょ}⟦{付|づ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: neighborly relations, getting along with neighbors
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{近所|きんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in this neighborhood

Related words:
- ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧: nearby (more general location)
- ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧: next door (immediate neighbor)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧: surroundings
